Fire is one of the deadliest such incidents in the popular tourist destination in ⁠recent years At least 27 people have ⁠been killed in a ⁠fire ​at a pub in Bangkok, Thailand’s prime minister and other officials said ⁠on Monday, in one of the deadliest such incidents in the tourism hub in ⁠recent years. “There are more than 27 dead,” said ​Anwut Pho-ampai, of ‌the Ruamkatanyu Foundation, which ‌operates a voluntary emergency rescue service. Prime minister Anutin Charnvirakul, ‌who visited the site of the fire in the early hours of Monday, told reporters that based on survivor accounts, the pub rapidly filled with smoke after a fire broke out, forcing ‌many to run to the back of the venue near the bathrooms, but there ​were no fire escapes.

A huge fire engulfed a pub in Bangkok early on Monday morning, killing at least 27 people before firefighters brought the blaze under control, officials said. Footage shared online by first responders shows a huge blaze raging and plumes coming out of the front door of the Na Ladprao pub in the northern part of the Thai capital. People are seen trying to flee as thick black smoke billows into the sky. Rescuers said the fire was reported around midnight. Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul told reporters at the scene that 27 people died and that several of the injured have been taken to the hospital. He said the cause of the fire is under investigation.

Firefighters say a deadly blaze at a Bangkok pub took about half an hour to bring under control. People are seen trying to flee as thick black smoke billows into the sky. Rescuers said the fire was reported around midnight. Thai rescuers recovered the mobile phones of several victims of the fatal pub blaze. Photo: AAP

Fire is one of the deadliest such incidents in the popular tourist destination in ⁠recent years

At least 27 people have ⁠been killed in a ⁠fire ​at a pub in Bangkok, Thailand’s prime minister and other officials said ⁠on Monday, in one of the deadliest such incidents in the tourism hub in ⁠recent years.

“There are more than 27 dead,” said ​Anwut Pho-ampai, of ‌the Ruamkatanyu Foundation, which ‌operates a voluntary emergency rescue service.

Prime minister Anutin Charnvirakul, ‌who visited the site of the fire in the early hours of Monday, told reporters that based on survivor accounts, the pub rapidly filled with smoke after a fire broke out, forcing ‌many to run to the back of the venue near the bathrooms, but there ​were no fire escapes.

“We have recovered 27 bodies, others are being sent to hospital,” Anutin said.

A Bangkok metropolitan administration official said 63 people were injured in ⁠the fire.

Exact details were not immediately clear, ​but the ​fire was believed to ​have started at the Rong Beer Na ​Lat Phrao ‌pub in Bangkok’s ​Chatuchak district, local media reported.

---

[Lähde: CBS News | URL: https://www.cbsnews.com/news/bangkok-na-ladprao-beer-pub-deadly-fire/]
A huge fire engulfed a pub in Bangkok early on Monday morning, killing at least 27 people before firefighters brought the blaze under control, officials said.

Footage shared online by first responders shows a huge blaze raging and plumes coming out of the front door of the Na Ladprao pub in the northern part of the Thai capital. People are seen trying to flee as thick black smoke billows into the sky. Rescuers said the fire was reported around midnight.

Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul told reporters at the scene that 27 people died and that several of the injured have been taken to the hospital. He said the cause of the fire is under investigation.

Anutin said a musician who was performing at the pub told him that he saw smoke coming out of a circuit breaker near the stage before the power went out, then an explosion was heard and thick smoke quickly filled the place.

Many of the victims were found in the restrooms, at the back of the pub, Anutin added.

Firefighters took about half an hour to bring the fire under control. Photos of the aftermath show charred tables and chairs, and the damaged interior of the pub.

Thailand has seen similar tragedies in the past. In 2022, 14 people were killed by a fire at a music pub in the eastern part of the country.

More than a decade before that, 66 people were killed and more than 200 were injured in a fire during a Jan. 1, 2009, New Year's Eve celebration at the Santika nightclub in Thailand's capital. That blaze was apparently sparked by an indoor fireworks display.

payload.title: Ainakin 27 ihmistä kuoli pubipalossa Bangkokissa
payload.summary: Bangkokissa sijaitsevan Na Ladprao -pubin tulipalossa kuoli ainakin 27 ihmistä. Useita loukkaantuneita vietiin sairaalaan, ja viranomaiset tutkivat palon syytä.
payload.content:
Ainakin 27 ihmistä kuoli ja useita loukkaantui Na Ladprao -pubin tulipalossa Thaimaan pääkaupungissa Bangkokissa varhain maanantaiaamuna. Eloonjääneiden kertomusten mukaan rakennus täyttyi nopeasti savulla, ja monet pakoon pyrkineet joutuivat pubin takaosaan lähelle wc-tiloja, joissa ei ollut hätäuloskäyntejä.

## Palo ilmoitettiin puolenyön aikaan

Pelastajien mukaan tulipalosta ilmoitettiin noin puolenyön aikaan. Pohjois-Bangkokissa sijaitseva pubi oli voimakkaiden liekkien vallassa ennen kuin palokunta sai palon hallintaan. Palomiesten mukaan sammuttamiseen kului noin puoli tuntia. Viranomaiset kertoivat vähintään 27 ihmisen kuolleen, ja useita loukkaantuneita kuljetettiin sairaalaan.

Ensivastehenkilöstön verkossa jakamilla videoilla näkyy suuria liekkejä sekä pubin etuovesta purkautuvaa savua. Paksu musta savu kohoaa kuvissa ilmaan samalla, kun ihmiset yrittävät paeta rakennuksesta. Thaimaalaiset pelastajat löysivät palopaikalta myös useiden uhrien matkapuhelimia.

## Savu ajoi ihmisiä rakennuksen takaosaan

Thaimaan pääministeri Anutin Charnvirakul kävi palopaikalla varhain maanantaina. Hän kertoi toimittajille, että eloonjääneiden kuvausten perusteella pubi täyttyi nopeasti savulla palon sytyttyä. Monet ihmiset juoksivat rakennuksen takaosaan lähelle wc-tiloja, mutta pääministerin mukaan siellä ei ollut palo- tai hätäuloskäyntejä, joiden kautta he olisivat voineet poistua.

Vapaaehtoista pelastuspalvelua ylläpitävän Ruamkatanyu-säätiön edustaja Anwut Pho-ampai sanoi kuolleita olevan yli 27. Pääministeri puolestaan kertoi palopaikalla 27 ihmisen kuolleen. Viranomaisten ja pelastuspalvelun ilmoittamat tiedot osoittavat, että vahvistettu uhrimäärä oli maanantaina vähintään 27.

## Palon syytä tutkitaan

Tulipalon syytä ei ole vielä selvitetty. Charnvirakulin mukaan tapahtuneesta on aloitettu tutkinta, jossa selvitetään palon syttymistä ja tapahtumien kulkua. Bangkokin pubipalo on lähteiden mukaan yksi Thaimaan suositussa matkailukohteessa viime vuosina sattuneista kuolonuhrien määrällä mitattuna vakavimmista vastaavista tulipaloista. Palon nopea leviäminen, rakennuksen täyttyminen savulla ja takaosan hätäuloskäyntien puuttuminen ovat keskeisiä tapahtumista tähän mennessä kerrottuja tietoja.
summary_bullets: Na Ladprao -pubin palossa kuoli ainakin 27 ihmistä.
Palon syy ja tapahtumien kulku ovat tutkittavina.
payload.journalist_note: Uhriluku on alustava: pääministeri kertoi 27 kuolemasta, mutta vapaaehtoisen pelastuspalvelun edustajan mukaan kuolleita on yli 27.

Vapaaehtoista pelastuspalvelua ylläpitävän Ruamkatanyu-säätiön edustaja Anwut Pho-ampai sanoi kuolleita olevan yli 27. Pääministeri puolestaan kertoi palopaikalla 27 ihmisen kuolleen. Viranomaisten ja pelastuspalvelun ilmoittamat tiedot osoittavat, että vahvistettu uhrimäärä oli maanantaina vähintään 27.

## Palon syytä tutkitaan

Tulipalon syytä ei ole vielä selvitetty. Charnvirakulin mukaan tapahtuneesta on aloitettu tutkinta, jossa selvitetään palon syttymistä ja tapahtumien kulkua. Bangkokin pubipalo on lähteiden mukaan yksi Thaimaan suositussa matkailukohteessa viime vuosina sattuneista kuolonuhrien määrällä mitattuna vakavimmista vastaavista tulipaloista. Palon nopea leviäminen, rakennuksen täyttyminen savulla ja takaosan hätäuloskäyntien puuttuminen ovat keskeisiä tapahtumista tähän mennessä kerrottuja tietoja.

Fire is one of the deadliest such incidents in the popular tourist destination in ⁠recent years At least 27 people have ⁠been killed in a ⁠fire ​at a pub in Bangkok, Thailand’s prime minister and other officials said ⁠on Monday, in one of the deadliest such incidents in the tourism hub in ⁠recent years. “There are more than 27 dead,” said ​Anwut Pho-ampai, of ‌the Ruamkatanyu Foundation, which ‌operates a voluntary emergency rescue service. Prime minister Anutin Charnvirakul, ‌who visited the site of the fire in the early hours of Monday, told reporters that based on survivor accounts, the pub rapidly filled with smoke after a fire broke out, forcing ‌many to run to the back of the venue near the bathrooms, but there ​were no fire escapes.

A huge fire engulfed a pub in Bangkok early on Monday morning, killing at least 27 people before firefighters brought the blaze under control, officials said. Footage shared online by first responders shows a huge blaze raging and plumes coming out of the front door of the Na Ladprao pub in the northern part of the Thai capital. People are seen trying to flee as thick black smoke billows into the sky. Rescuers said the fire was reported around midnight. Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul told reporters at the scene that 27 people died and that several of the injured have been taken to the hospital. He said the cause of the fire is under investigation.
